messages:
Faye: Quick huddle note \u2014 customers asking for clearer onboarding launch gates + a transparent credit formula for migrations. Want a short proposal to share with sales.
Omar: +1. We keep patching ad-hoc credits. Can we define an objective credit calculator tied to migration effort and lost reliability?
Priya: Proposal: credit = min(50%, base * effort_multiplier). base = avg monthly spend over last 3 months. effort_multiplier = 0.25 for minor opt-in, 0.5 for shim work, 1.0 for breaking schema changes.
Will: Legal note: anything >30% requires an approved SOW for enterprise. Also track credits as bill adjustment tickets with audit trail.
Faye: Good. For launch gates I propose three tiers: Sandbox (internal QA + 5 synthetic slices), Pilot (3 customers or 48h shadow), GA (bench pass + telemetry + customer opt-in window).
Omar: Bench pass thresholds? Historically 95% suite pass on primary metrics. Add per-metric absolute guards: e.g., F1 drop <=1.5 points, latency p95 <= +150ms.
Priya: Add lineage check: if model family has >10% migration incidents historically, require a canary cohort of 5 customers before Pilot. Also disallow auto promotions for pinned customers.
Will: Billing flow: when credit qualifies, issue provisional credit token that CS redeems on migration completion. Auto-expire token in 90 days. Also record associated RFC id for audit.
comms-bot: Note: last migration credits were manually approved for ticket 1834009876 (10% ad-hoc).
Faye: Communication template: early notice (30d), reminder (14/7/2d), day-of with rollback plan + contact. Include clear CTA to request pin or migration assistance.
Omar: Quick-exit rules: 1) bench regression >5% absolute on primary metric -> immediate rollback; 2) latency p95 +40% OR +300ms -> pause rollout; 3) customer-reported major functionality break -> manual hold and expedited CS path.
Priya: Ops guardrails: feature flag to disable auto-promote, telemetry dashboard card for new onboardings, and a 'why-not-promoted' reason code surfaced in Console.
Will: Action items + owners: Faye -> draft public one-pager and comms template (Tue EOD). Omar -> bench thresholds + scoring PoC (Fri). Priya -> lineage/contract mapping export (Wed). I'll prototype credit token flow with billing (next Tue).
Faye: I'll spin this into a short RFC after these deliverables. If no objections, proceed. :thumbsup:
Omar: No objections. Will post PoC link once ready.
Priya: +1. Will coordinate with CS for contact list.
comms-bot: Calendar created 1845200000 for RFC kickoff (invite sent).
